This page preserves the evidence passages formerly embedded in the Contract
landing page. Their checkpoint names, temporal wording, outcomes, and limits
are retained verbatim; they describe those recorded observations, not a new
execution of the current course. Use the [Contract map](index.qmd) for public

mechanisms.

## Retained evidence record

On source `9cd5d4e1a27adc4e9c8719370c8a38a86177f8c9`, one bounded Linux
x86-64 exercise made two calls to the same public multi-View Optimization
request, creating two attempts, plus one 61-point two-Port Direct request. The
first Optimization call was interrupted only after its verified baseline
checkpoint was published; the second reused that exact checkpoint and
completed one generation of two candidates. A third independent Python
process then resolved the exact Optimization and Direct
Results with execution entries denied and zero Julia launches, and saved a
self-contained Report plus named `signal_in` to `resonator_probe` S-magnitude
and phase plots; its enclosing private diagnostic exited afterward while
serializing a nested complex ledger value. This remains `CONVERGING` evidence,
not a generalized replay, full-suite, macOS, performance, attainment, or
acceptance claim.

Additional multi-generation exercises, other-platform coverage, historical
regression stabilization, and release delivery are separate future scopes;
they are not unfinished CP5 work.

The historical `1.0.0.dev7` research showcase keeps the new README and presentation
refinements `CONVERGING`. Optimization declarations and retained-Result labels
now expose readable scalar-selection and View settings, while comparison
Figures and reports separate fixed settings from initial/best-found values.
The unchanged Chapter 4 diagram and raw/PTC response assets remain the public
numerical examples. This checkpoint has source- and mechanism-level checks for
the comparison formatter, but no newly generated retained-Result comparison
image: the preserved historical Result requires an exact catalog source that
is not available in the retained readback environment, and no substitute Plan
or Result is accepted.

Current CI exercises portable-wheel identity, a small current-API
Direct/pump-off HB/resolve smoke, runtime preparation, Notebook parity,
source-bound figures, static publication, and unchanged standalone RLGC rejection
and HB failure-classifier checks. Engineer Chapter 1 has one explicitly
generated source-bound authoring diagram, two typed-result S11 presentations,
complex response data, and a quantity table. Chapter 2 has source-bound
three-point sweep evidence, a genuine fixed-request
Optimization winner with independent root readback and selected diagram, and
optional grid/listed-point evidence. The course web build launches no solver,
Chapter 3 adds a named three-sample two-Port Direct Result plus certified
standalone feedline and readout illustrations. Its complete Plan's Default
diagram remains a typed `schematic_layout` failure, so those distinct
illustration Plans are not represented as a successful projection of it.
Chapter 4 adds the certified explicit four-Port capstone, separately labeled
raw and PTC Direct core Results, and optional transformed-view scalar-response,
Direct, and pump-off HB
evidence. Direct and HB preserve their separately declared grids without
interpolation. Chapter 5 adds one certified reusable-Composite occurrence whose
public surface includes both physical parameter refs, equivalent ordinary
Pins, and one explicitly published Coordinate. Chapter 6 adds certified
Default, T, Cross, and exact-Plan reuse diagrams without changing the Plan to
satisfy presentation. Chapter 7 records typed authoring and compiled diagram
limitations alongside three successful Direct points and all sixteen labeled
four-Port channels; its plotted `[0,0]` trace is identified only as one
reflection example. Chapter 8 records two distinct Jupyter kernel sessions:
the first persists Direct/root Results and a Report, and the second reconstructs
the exact declaration and calls only `resolve()` while leaving the shared
workspace bytes unchanged. These assets do not establish execution of every
compiled projection. The [figure inventory](../../examples/README.md) records
the current source-bound evidence and typed layout limitations. The sixteen
former Chapter URLs are short migration guides; superseded executable bodies,
Notebooks, and checkpoint figures remain in Git history.

Retained tests have three distinct evidence roles: current runnable checks;
numerical and integrity regressions blocked by superseded authoring fixtures;
and superseded historical expectations that are not current product authority.
Old-fixture failures do not invalidate downstream numerical assertions, and
historical expectations do not decide the unaccepted replacement semantics.
Their bodies remain historical evidence pending authorized stabilization; no
full historical-suite pass or whole-course execution is claimed. No release,
consumer migration, or scientific acceptance follows from this evidence.
